coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available, so trial registries, regulator databases, preprint servers, citation graphs, DOI metadata services, patents, chemistry sources, and non-PubMed subject indexes cannot be searched directly.
Forward- and backward-citation expansion is limited to relationships and references discoverable through PubMed records rather than a dedicated citation graph.
Recent unindexed, preprint-only, non-English records without an English abstract, and full-text-only mechanistic details may be missed.
PubMed publication-date fields can incompletely represent online-first and correction timing; cutoff ambiguity requires post-retrieval adjudication.
exclusion_criteria: Studies of LRRK1 or unrelated kinases without direct LRRK2 evidence.
Parkinson disease records that mention LRRK2 only incidentally and provide no genetic, mechanistic, substrate, physiological, or limiting evidence.
Purely generic pathway studies lacking an explicit LRRK2 manipulation, measurement, genotype, interaction, or substrate relationship.
Editorials, news items, and unsupported opinion pieces that neither contribute primary evidence nor lead to an identifiable primary study.
Conference-only records with insufficient methods or results for claim assessment.
Duplicate reports that add no distinct cohort, experiment, correction, follow-up, or version information.
inclusion_criteria: Publication date is on or before 2024-12-31 after reconciling online-first, issue, correction, and retraction dates.
The record directly addresses LRRK2 genetics, a Parkinson-associated variant, enzymatic activity, physiological substrates, downstream physiology, or evidence limiting those claims.
Human genetic cohorts, pedigrees, patient tissue, patient-derived models, biochemical systems, cell models, and animal models are eligible when their evidence layer is explicitly identified.
Primary research is eligible for claim support; reviews and historical summaries are eligible only for terminology expansion, chronology checks, and locating primary records.
Null, negative, contradictory, replication, correction, retraction, incomplete-penetrance, population-specific, and model-dependent findings are eligible.
Records in any language are eligible when an English title or abstract provides enough information for screening, with unresolved full-text language limitations recorded.
Duplicate canonical records are merged by PMID or DOI while every query-to-record occurrence and corrected or retracted version link is preserved.

queries.purpose: Recover anchor literature spanning the initial genetic association, named variants, and Parkinson disease while validating target aliases.
queries.query: ("Leucine-Rich Repeat Kinase 2"[Mesh] OR LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab] OR dardarin[tiab]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR Parkinson*[tiab]) AND (mutation*[tiab] OR variant*[tiab] OR discover*[tiab] OR linkage[tiab])

queries.purpose: Preserve the original target and disease wording as a high-precision terminology check.
Trace linkage, cloning, pedigree, and segregation evidence underlying genetic discovery.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab] OR dardarin[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (linkage[tiab] OR "positional cloning"[tiab] OR "gene discovery"[tiab] OR pedigree*[tiab] OR familial[tiab] OR segregation[tiab])

queries.purpose: Retrieve variant-specific pathogenicity, risk, penetrance, ancestry, founder, and phenotype evidence.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441C[tiab] OR R1441G[tiab] OR R1441H[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab] OR N1437H[tiab] OR G2385R[tiab] OR R1628P[tiab] OR "pathogenic variant"[tiab] OR "risk variant"[tiab]) AND (penetrance[tiab] OR frequency[tiab] OR population*[tiab] OR ancestry[tiab] OR founder[tiab] OR segregation[tiab] OR phenotype*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Map disease-associated variants onto kinase, GTPase, domain-coupling, and phosphorylation mechanisms.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (kinase[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab] OR "ROC domain"[tiab] OR "COR domain"[tiab] OR autophosphorylation[tiab] OR phosphorylation[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441*[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab] OR pathogenic[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Identify proposed physiological substrates and evidence that their phosphorylation is endogenous and LRRK2-dependent.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (substrate*[tiab] OR phosphoproteom*[tiab] OR "Rab GTPase"[tiab] OR RAB10[tiab] OR RAB8A[tiab]) AND (physiolog*[tiab] OR endogenous[tiab] OR phosphorylation[tiab] OR kinase[tiab])

queries.purpose: Retrieve studies connecting LRRK2 substrate signaling to cellular physiology and Parkinson-relevant phenotypes.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND ("vesicle trafficking"[tiab] OR lysosom*[tiab] OR autophag*[tiab] OR mitochondri*[tiab] OR cili*[tiab] OR "immune signaling"[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR neuron*[tiab] OR dopaminerg*[tiab] OR physiolog*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Focus on direct chains of evidence from disease variant through enzymatic change or Rab phosphorylation to disease-relevant outcomes.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441*[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab]) AND ("kinase activity"[tiab] OR "GTPase activity"[tiab] OR "Rab phosphorylation"[tiab] OR RAB10[tiab]) AND (pathogen*[tiab] OR neurodegener*[tiab] OR dopaminerg*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Test whether the proposed enzymatic and substrate mechanism is supported in human cohorts, tissues, biomarkers, or patient-derived models.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (patient*[tiab] OR human[tiab] OR cohort*[tiab] OR "patient-derived"[tiab] OR iPSC[tiab] OR biomarker*[tiab] OR neuropatholog*[tiab]) AND (kinase[tiab] OR phosphorylation[tiab] OR RAB10[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Expand from substrate anchors into linked targets, pathways, and physiological consequences discoverable within PubMed.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (Rab*[tiab] OR RAB10[tiab] OR RAB8A[tiab] OR phosphoproteom*[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab]) AND (interact*[tiab] OR pathway*[tiab] OR trafficking[tiab] OR lysosom*[tiab] OR cili*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence limiting causality or generality, including incomplete penetrance, population or model dependence, null findings, inhibitor liabilities, corrections, and retractions.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab] OR Rab*[tiab]) AND (negative[tiab] OR null[tiab] OR contradict*[tiab] OR inconsistent[tiab] OR replication[tiab] OR penetrance[tiab] OR knockout[tiab] OR inhibitor*[tiab] OR toxicity[tiab] OR "model dependent"[tiab] OR "population specific"[tiab] OR Retracted Publication[pt] OR Retraction of Publication[pt] OR correction[pt])

queries.purpose: Capture recent indexed genetic, mechanistic, substrate, and limiting evidence through the delivery cutoff.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR Parkinson*[tiab]) AND (genetic*[tiab] OR variant*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab] OR Rab*[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab]) AND (2023:2024[pdat])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: from database inception through 2024-12-31, assess how human genetic discovery and disease-associated LRRK2 variants connect altered kinase/GTPase activity and physiological substrate phosphorylation to Parkinson disease across human cohorts, patient-derived systems, biochemical studies, cells, and animal models; retain null, contradictory, population-limited, and model-limited evidence. Include all languages when an English title or abstract permits eligibility assessment, and use reviews only for historical orientation, terminology discovery, and navigation to primary studies.
stop_rules: Complete all twelve planned PubMed query events across sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update waves.

Confirm that sentinel retrieval recovers primary anchors for genetic discovery, recurrent disease-associated variants, enzymatic mechanism, and LRRK2-dependent Rab substrate phosphorylation; revise aliases within the fixed query budget if an anchor class is absent.
Stop expansion after two consecutive expansion passes add no decision-relevant primary evidence or new eligible terminology, variant, substrate, pathway, or limiting-evidence category.

Stop when each brief section has at least one directly relevant primary evidence stream and every high-impact mechanistic claim has a targeted challenge search, while unsupported sections remain declared gaps.
Stop at the maximum budget of twelve query events even if saturation is incomplete, and report budget exhaustion in coverage gaps.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when PubMed indexing or publication-date semantics are ambiguous.
Preserve deterministic deduplication by PMID and DOI while retaining all query-to-record links, corrections, and retractions.
